facts.text: Established as New Jersey's first four-year college for women, Saint Elizabeth University became coeducational in 2016 while maintaining its historic focus on women's education.

sources.title: Nicole Yanoso '04 Named Inaugural Director of Sr. Francis Raftery ...
sources.quote: Originally established as New Jersey's first four-year college for women, the University became coeducational in 2016 while maintaining its historic commitment to women's education, leadership, and empowerment.
